statistics.bootstrap: 10,000 draws seed 20261018, blocks resampled when cells are blocked, trials nested

gates.placement_ok: every decoder/competitor mask: distinct physical CUs == requested, per-XCD counts differ by <= 1
gates.lifecycle_ok: every competitor: started event, stopped event, PID gone, no owned residual GPU process
gates.outputs_ok: Qwen32B pilot runs complete with one output digest across all CU levels and treatments
gates.leak_ok: v1, recorded only: probe TFLOP/s during decoder trials >= 0.85 x probe alone on the same mask
gates.leak_ok_v11: every decoder probe ratio (probe during decoder / probe alone) >= 0.85 x the highest ratio of the same probe beside a placement-proven native co-runner (fma or read) on the decoder mask, same GPU
gates.clock_ok: pooled in-window gfx and memory clocks over Qwen32B E2 pilot trials: max/min <= 1.05, coverage >= 0.5
gates.release_e2: placement_ok and outputs_ok (observational label if clock_ok fails)
gates.release_e3_full: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v11 and clock_ok
gates.release_e3_minimal: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v11
gates.leak_ok_v2: v1.3, predeclared before any per-CU data: per-CU probe rate ratio r_c = rate_c(beside X) / rate_c(probe alone), same GPU and probe mask; q_c = r_c / median_c(r_c). Every run covers all 304-n probe CUs. Sensitivity: the positive-control run (probe co-runner sharing 8 CUs) has >= 4 CUs with q_c < 0.85, else the test is insensitive and leak_ok_v2 is false. Pass iff, for every decoder run, min_c q_c >= (lowest min_c q_c of the native read/fma co-runner runs on the same GPU and mask) - 0.05
gates.release_e3_minimal_v2: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v2
gates.leak_ok_v3: v1.5, predeclared before any duration-probe data (docs/amd/mi350x_followup_plan_20261103.md): the leak_ok_v2 rule applied to per-CU speed s_c = completed probe workgroups / summed workgroup residency (svc_bench_v5 cuprobe_t) instead of completion rate. Natives: co-runners on 0..n-1; positive controls: fma, read and the v4 full-LDS probe on 0..n+7 (8 shared CUs), each of which must flag >= 4 CUs with q_c < 0.85, else the test is insensitive and leak_ok_v3 is false
gates.release_e3_minimal_v3: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v3
gates.leak_ok_v4: v1.6, predeclared before any start-delay-probe data (docs/amd/followups_v16_plan_20261104.md): svc_bench_v6 gapprobe on n..FULL-1, one full-LDS 16-wave workgroup per probe CU per launch, 200 us host gap. Per CU c: f_c = (launches whose first workgroup on c started > 5 us after the launch's first start + launches with no workgroup on c) / launches; e_c = f_c(beside X) - f_c(alone), same GPU and mask; c is flagged if e_c >= 0.10. The alone run must cover all FULL-n probe CUs. Sensitivity: the v4 full-LDS probe on 0..n+7 and the decoder on 0..n+7 must each flag >= 4 CUs (fma and read on 0..n+7 are recorded, not required), else the test is insensitive and leak_ok_v4 is false. Pass iff every decoder run at n flags no more CUs than the most flagged by a native read/fma co-runner on 0..n-1, on every GPU and level
gates.release_e3_minimal_v4: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and outputs_ok and leak_ok_v4
